documents.rotation: JWT refresh tokens rotate after authentication. Reusing a revoked refresh token fails verification.
documents.tenant: Every query requires a tenant identifier. Foreign tenant documents are excluded even when their wording matches.
documents.outbox: A transactional outbox commits the job and event in PostgreSQL together. The publisher retries Redis delivery after a failure.
documents.ack: The worker acknowledges the Redis message only after committing job success. A crash before acknowledgement causes safe replay.
documents.rrf: Reciprocal rank fusion combines dense and sparse ordering using reciprocal ranks, not incomparable raw similarity scores.
documents.code: Error E429 indicates a rate limit. Retry E429 with bounded exponential backoff and jitter.
documents.object: Raw document bytes live in object storage. PostgreSQL stores immutable version metadata and checksums.
documents.graph: Aurora calls Borealis. Borealis depends on Cygnus. Relationship traversal discovers multi-hop dependencies.
documents.fruit: Bananas grow in tropical climates. Apples and oranges are popular fruits.
documents.capital: Paris is the capital of France. Berlin is the capital of Germany.

queries.text: What happens when a refresh token is reused?

When does the worker acknowledge the message?
Why not add dense and sparse similarity scores?
Where are the original document bytes kept?
